subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept the announceLastRun persisted marker and killed non-running reconciliation state for interrupted subagent completion announce turns?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it changes serialized session recovery semantics and a security-relevant tool boundary, which are maintainer-owned merge risks rather than routine contributor cleanup.

options.title: Accept marker and killed state after lint is clean
options.body: Rerun or resolve check-lint, then land if maintainers agree that aborted announce delivery should clear recovery markers and persist the parent session as non-running killed.

options.title: Choose a different non-running state
options.body: If killed is not the desired persisted state for a lost delivery-only announce turn, update the recovery patch to the maintainer-approved terminal state before merge.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery model
options.body: If maintainers want one recovery model for all inter-session delivery turns instead of an announce-specific marker, pause this PR and route that design first.

recommendation.title: Accept marker and killed state after lint is clean
recommendation.body: Rerun or resolve check-lint, then land if maintainers agree that aborted announce delivery should clear recovery markers and persist the parent session as non-running killed.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman has recent history on restart recovery lifecycle seams and Codex internal-turn behavior across the main affected surfaces.
